replication.target_description: Experiment 4 in online supplement, English-speaking Mechanical Turk participants from India; BIDR SDE outcome. Main article identifies this study but does not print its target statistics.

reported_success.quote: None of the studies provided any evidence that honesty priming increases candor of responding.

notes: Original full primary paper unavailable: DOI landing not accessible; CiteSeer PDF returned 404/timeout; Unpaywall and OpenAlex report no open-access location. Original statistics quoted secondarily in replication paper were not used. Supplied replication page locators appear to refer to a manuscript rather than the six-page published article. Supplement target statistics could not be independently acquired: publisher full-page fetch returned 429; publisher CDN supplement DOC and PDF routes returned 403 and were not retried. Main-paper narrative supports the reported failure, but no sample size, effect size or p value for the fourth study was substituted from other studies or sources.
